relations: The descending metal block presses onto the hammer head, deforming it against the striped platform.
As the block lowers, the hammer transmits compression into the scattered rubble beneath it.
Small debris fragments shift and scatter outward when the press contacts the hammer.
The hammer's handle bends under the block's weight while remaining trapped between press and platform.
